app.title: Property Acquisition Scenarios Tool
app.caption: Planning support only. Use this to compare acquisition and transition scenarios, not to produce legal, valuation, or construction-grade numbers.

sidebar.core_caption: Money inputs below are in NOK millions (M) unless marked as % or years.
sidebar.use_ministry_baseline: Use ministry baseline to derive free cash
sidebar.annual_ministry_other_cost: Annual ministry running cost excl. property (M)
sidebar.manual_annual_member_cashflow: Manual annual free cash after church operations (M)

summary.title: Executive summary
summary.caption: This page is for board and elder review. It pulls the main conclusion from the detailed tabs into one decision view.
summary.compare_caption: Use this section to answer a practical board question: if we move to this exact property, do we improve member access fairly compared with where we are today?
summary.bottom_line_caption: This page reuses the live outputs from the detailed tabs so the board summary stays consistent with the working case.

screening.title: Screening and diligence framework
screening.caption_1: Use this as the front door for the candidate case: record what is actually confirmed, then score the remaining assumptions.
screening.caption_2: Sidebar inputs already hold price, financing, floors, and ministry baseline. This tab is for gateway judgment, diligence status, and fit.
screening.confirmed_facts_caption: Use these fields for facts you believe are actually checked. These statuses override weaker heuristic slider values in the summary below.
screening.assumptions_caption: These are directional judgments where you may not have hard confirmation yet.
screening.financial_snapshot_caption: This keeps the non-technical project risks visible in the same gateway tab: funding pressure, lease dependence, contingency strength, and execution complexity.
screening.checklist_caption: This is the working checklist behind the summary above. Use it to keep unknowns explicit and assign the next concrete verification task.

space.title: Space utilization
space.caption: This is the floor-by-floor planning base for the rest of the tool. Define what each floor is for here, then use the same floor logic in Renovation Cost and Income Generation.
space.summary_caption: Decision-maker reading: this tab defines the intended role of each floor. The same floor plan should be visible again in renovation scope and income assumptions.

renovation.title: Renovation / conversion scenarios
renovation.caption: This model now follows the same floor logic as Space Utilization. Decide which floors are in scope, what area is being touched on each floor, and then add the building-wide items that decision makers should see separately.
renovation.summary_caption: Decision-maker reading: the selected scenario combines floor-level work with shared building-wide cost.

income.title: Income generation
income.caption: This model uses the same floor plan as Space Utilization. Turn income on only for floors that can realistically produce it, and leave the others at zero.
income.summary_caption: Decision-maker reading: this scenario shows how many floors produce income and what net support remains after operating cost.
